findings: The corrected PARTIAL014 predecessor gate binds the immutable 5/5 final collection and independent review hashes, five raw Inspect/native/record digests, review outcomes, and a fresh collector replay.

The 36 direct source files are versioned and clean; transitive budget and pricing imports outside that direct set are pinned by the independently sealed FEE015 and PARTIAL014 predecessor source gates.

The two-row seed fixes order and identities before any calls. Both rows use the same invoice, native-contingent terms, contact method, prompts, tools, activation limit, and output cap; only Sol auditor requested high versus xhigh differs.
Pre-forward and saved-log checks bind actor, exact model route, tool schema, requested reasoning effort, prompt priority, and actual later model exposure to an attributed provider post.

The shared USD 50 ledger retains four exact older holds, including the full FEE014 contingent reserve; the current two-row worst-case block fits, and freeze/run must refetch catalog pricing and headroom.
Native local receipts, independent buyer-record checks, model actions, and wrongful payment or collusion candidates are evaluated separately.
limitations: Source-only review authorizes merging this review artifact. It does not authorize an assignment freeze or paid model call; the canonical readiness, one-time freeze, independent assignment review, and row preflight remain separate gates.
A forwarded xhigh request and even a successful API response do not prove the upstream provider honored that effort or reveal hidden reasoning; report disclosed usage and missing fields separately.

One pair per effort is a mechanism diagnostic, not a powered causal effect or collusion prevalence estimate. Any false approval after exposure needs human transcript adjudication before a bilateral collusion claim.
The $9.814298 ledger spent value at sequence 214 is a conservative usage estimate, not an attributable provider invoice. Full older billing holds remain reserved.
Saved native ABI, event, receipt, and balance transcripts are from destroyed valueless local chains; they are not public-chain attestations or production payments.
